notes: Re-done Oct 28 from a sharp square-on 1080p frame (the Demo 43 globe was traced from a 960 px contact-sheet tile and came out as a blob). The 2016 AT&T globe is built geometrically instead of traced: a disc cut by four latitude gaps that bow down in the middle and taper from wide at the left rim to almost nothing at the right, which is exactly how the lit sign reads in the frame (five separate lit blue pieces). Sizes from the frame with the dark fascia band taken as 1.25 m (band 147 px): globe 0.83 m, 'AT&T' cap 0.53 m and 1.64 m across, 0.09 m gap, whole mark 2.58 m, centred vertically in the band (the letters sit ~3 cm higher than the globe's centre). Letters: AT&T's own bold grotesque, set in Inter Bold at 0.9 width to the measured span. Colours: fascia #222525 in shadow (it is a glossy dark graphite that reflects the hall's lights on its right half), globe reads #125faf in the photo but is a lit face, letters #eaefee lit white. Interior behind (for the walk-in): grey carpet tile, white gondolas and wall bays of phones, a big back-lit 'iPhone PRO' poster on the left wall, round white tables with chairs, a counter at the back, slate-grey tile pilasters, dark open ceiling with track lights.
